brief:
The Israeli human rights organization B'Tselem has characterized settler violence as part of a systematic effort to eliminate Palestinian existence in the occupied territories, Al Jazeera English reported. The group contends that attacks by Israeli settlers follow a deliberate pattern designed to drive Palestinians from their land.

B'Tselem's assessment frames the violence not as isolated incidents but as coordinated actions serving a broader territorial objective. The organization documents such incidents as part of its monitoring of rights violations in occupied Palestinian areas.
dek: Israeli rights group B’Tselem says Israeli settler violence aims to eliminate Palestinian existence.
title: Israeli settlers wage campaign to erase Palestinian presence, B'Tselem says
